historicalBest.selectionRule: Among the four archived English SQLite runs in release-0.1.0/manifest.json, require complete strict and numerical grading by both judges; maximize the sum of both strict correct counts. Select one whole run, never per-question maxima.

limits: A small development set, not the full LongMemEval benchmark or an independent held-out estimate.
One new answer per question and arm; no repeated runs selected for the current table.
Strict verdicts and 1–10 partial-credit grades are independent.
Full-text inputs, answers, verdict reasons, request payloads and source snapshots remain external.
Reproduction requires the external artifacts and their recorded hashes; provider responses are nondeterministic.
